datasets.title: Syria: Settlement Map
datasets.description: A vector representation of the built-up surface, spatially aggregated within a 50m radius. From the Atlas of Human Settlements 2021 @ Syria.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/syria-settlement-map]
datasets.details: This limited public release covers the countries of Turkey and Syria for the year 2021, showing the extent of human settlements. This geospatial data is a machine-learning inference-based product that meets stringent model quality tests but has not been physically ground-truthed in the field.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery was processed using encoder-decoder convolutional neural networks and advanced computer vision algorithms to identify built-up surfaces, then spatially aggregated within 50m radius buffers to create a vector settlement map representing the built environment across Syria.

sources.name: Atlas of Human Settlements 2021
sources.description: Satellite-derived built-up surface mapping using deep convolutional neural networks and computer vision techniques to identify settlement extents across Syria.
